title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Duo #25 (GeorgianMinonkari+EgyptianMamluk / MoroccanZellige+KlimtMosaic)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult French woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, sultry, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in twin-tail, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her LEFT side is painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her RIGHT side is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following every crease, dense geometric star inlay filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Left woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform wedges, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, demure and soft, bright golden-blonde hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following every crease, dense organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform lace-up sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
